entities.summary: The Allied Democratic Forces is a Ugandan Islamist rebel group based in western Uganda and eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Some refer to the group as IS-DRC as a chapter of IS-CAP, but this terms is broader and tends to include non-ADF rebels. It is considered a terrorist organization by the Ugandan government and the United States. The group is sanctioned by the United States and the United Nations Security Council. Originally based in western Uganda, the ADF has expanded into eastern DRC where nearly all of its fighting has occurred. Allied Democratic Forces is a armed organization in Africa, established in 1995. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) has been responsible for thousands of deaths and displacements in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo since its establishment in 1995. The group's activities have also disrupted regional stability and economic development.
